executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-09-03 reviewed eight relevant items and found no confirmed material directional change. New capacity and improved yields could relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
